questions.stem: A 25-year-old woman presents with dry, flaky skin, particularly on her hands and feet. On examination, her skin appears rough and has a tendency to peel. You suspect a genetic mutation affecting a specific protein critical for skin barrier function. Which layer of the epidermis is primarily responsible for producing this protein, and what is its function?

options.label: A
options.text: Stratum spinosum, regulating melanin production and skin pigmentation.

options.label: B
options.text: Stratum lucidum, enhancing skin elasticity and collagen synthesis.

options.label: C
options.text: Stratum basale, promoting cell proliferation and wound healing.

options.label: D
options.text: Stratum granulosum, facilitating keratinocyte maturation and formation of the skin barrier.
